entry_price_rule: Use the official regular close on 2026-11-19. If unavailable, use the first official regular close after 2026-11-19 and disclose the substitution.
price_source: Nasdaq official historical data when available
return_definition: Price return only; do not label it total return.

comparisons.groups: score of 1 or more versus score of 0

missing_data_rule: Exclude a name only from the affected comparison. Count and print every exclusion.
statistics_rule: Report group sizes, means, medians, and direction. Do not claim statistical significance from this small sample.
change_rule: Preserve this file. Record a later change in a dated amendment. Do not rewrite the original design.
